module_signals.finding: UPGRADED from the prior card's -1, and the reason is specific. The 2026-08-12 card carried a source-grade warning: SEC EDGAR, nebius.com and businesswire were ALL blocked by the environment's egress proxy, so every Q2'26 number was tagged unverified_secondary. This run reached the SEC 6-K exhibit directly, and it CORROBORATES the secondary figures the prior card had to rely on (revenue $582.3M, AI cloud $574.9M, ARR $3.0B, adj EBITDA $236.2M, capex ~$5.7B, cash ~$8.0B, the $775M asset-backed facility, contracted power 5GW). That retires the source-grade penalty. It does NOT go above 0: active MW is still not disclosed (prior C114 OPEN, now a fourth consecutive quarter), and conflicts C110/C111 remain unresolved because this run did not reach the line items behind them.

Carried from 2026-08-12. Contracted capacity raised 4 -> 5 GW; four contracts signed in Q2 averaging over $1B TCV each; RPO $33.6B. But connected-power guidance was NOT raised (still 800MW-1GW by YE2026), which is the same reservation the prior card made.

Carried from 2026-08-12, which upgraded this leg 0 -> +1 on the single most important datapoint in that card: contracted revenue per MW moving from >$20M to a $40-50M/MW range on new signings. The commoditisation leg of the bear case was contradicted by transacted price, not by narrative.

Carried from 2026-08-12. Unit economics genuinely improved: adjusted EBITDA +$236.2M (40.6% group margin) against -$21.0M a year ago, cost of revenue down to 22.9% of revenue from 29%. Against that: Q2 operating cash flow of +$2.25B is driven by deferred revenue and working capital rather than operating quality, and with $5.66B of capex the quarter's free cash flow is about -$3.41B. GAAP net loss -$190.4M, EPS -$0.68.

Carried from 2026-08-12 and NOT relaxed. The commoditisation leg cooled; the LEVERAGE leg got hot. Non-current liabilities doubled in one quarter, $4.10B (YE2025) -> $8.50B (2026-06-30). First senior secured note $775M at SOFR+2.50% due 2030-10-31, collateralised by deployed GPUs and investment-grade customer contract cash flows, plus a $3.75B convertible plan. The prior card added K-G for exactly this and it stands.

Price $226.39. Against the actual 2026-08-13 close of $254.40 this is -11.0%. Still 26-51% ABOVE the $150-180 buy-below band, so nothing has changed for new money. Price is BELOW the >=$250 no-chase zone the prior card introduced, so that field is not currently triggered - though it WAS breached at $254.40 on 2026-08-13.

capital_cycle.read: Carried verbatim in substance from 2026-08-12, including its clarification that rising price per MW is NOT a falsification of this lens. High returns attracting capital is the FIRST step of the cycle, not its opposite. The variable that actually matters is the supply-response lead time - Volozh's point that transformers and gas generators are severely short. That lead time is the term of the excess return.

runner_dissent: Two things on record. FIRST, an error of my own: I built this card against the 07-10 baseline when 08-12 already existed on origin, because the local repo was 29 commits behind and I did not fetch before running the batch. The first draft then claimed to be withdrawing a 'warming' flag that the 08-12 card had already dropped - i.e. I was about to take credit for a judgement someone else had already made. Logged as INC-002. SECOND, the substantive point: the 08-12 card is in several ways BETTER than this one - it has RPO, revenue per MW, cost ratios and the leverage analysis that I did not independently reproduce. The one place this run genuinely adds value is source grade: I reached the primary 6-K that the 08-12 runner could not, and it corroborates the secondary numbers. That is worth exactly one module notch (M1 -1 -> 0) and nothing more. The verdict does not move, and it should not: the proof metric has now been absent for four straight quarters while the stock has compounded, which is the pattern that should make a buyer MORE patient, not less.
